dek: The Association for the Advancement of Medical Instrumentation runs its member community on WordPress and BuddyBoss. The homepage mixes curated stories with the community’s activity stream.
short: AAMI's member community on Bedrock WordPress and BuddyBoss, with a Timber theme and a homepage feed that blends curated stories with the live activity stream, cached in Redis and behind SAML single sign-on.

facts.label: Theme
facts.value: BuddyBoss child theme, Timber and Twig

delivery.summary: GitHub Actions deploy every environment branch to AWS. A separate Security Update workflow is dispatched from QA Pulse: it detects the PHP version, runs Composer updates, bumps git-tracked core, themes and plugins, and makes sure the Taoti Security Scanner loader is committed.

steps.name: Lint
steps.detail: PHP_CodeSniffer and Sass checks on push

steps.name: Deploy
steps.detail: taoti/actions-deploy-aws: build WordPress, back up, deploy, update the database, clear WordPress and CDN caches

steps.name: Promote
steps.detail: A confirmed promotion from one AWS environment to the next

steps.name: Security update
steps.detail: Dispatched from QA Pulse with a correlation id, pushed to a security-update branch

hosting.label: Local
hosting.value: Lando: PHP 8.3, Apache 2.4, MySQL 8.0, Redis, Xdebug

highlights.title: Curated first, then automatic
highlights.text: Admins drag curated items into order. The feed then fills from Events, Flagship Events, News, Certifications, Focus Areas and Standards, 15 items a page.

highlights.title: One post, two places
highlights.text: Each WordPress post is synced to a BuddyBoss activity, so it appears on the homepage and in the community stream. Curated posts from private groups show on the homepage and stay private in their group.

highlights.title: Cached, de-duplicated, invalidated
highlights.text: Feed data is cached, duplicates are detected across posts and activities, and the cache clears when the curated list changes. Admin tools backfill activities and clean up duplicates.
